questions.q: I like tea ___ coffee. (both)
questions.why: *and* поєднує два однорідні слова: *tea and coffee*.

questions.q: I was tired, ___ I went to bed early.
questions.why: *so* вводить наслідок: втомився → тому ліг рано.

questions.q: I stayed home ___ it was raining.
questions.why: *because* вводить причину: удома, бо йшов дощ.

questions.q: Do you want tea ___ coffee?
questions.why: У питанні з вибором — *or*: *tea or coffee?*

questions.q: She is poor, ___ she is happy.
questions.why: *but* — протиставлення: бідна, але щаслива.

questions.q: ___ Tom nor Anna came.
questions.why: *Neither … nor* — «ні … ні»: *Neither Tom nor Anna came.* Дієслово ствердне.

questions.q: You can have ___ tea or coffee.
questions.why: *either … or* — «або … або»: *either tea or coffee*.

questions.q: Which is correct?
options: Because I was tired, so I left.
Because I was tired, I left.
I was tired because so I left.
So because I was tired I left.
questions.why: *because* і *so* разом не вживаємо: або *Because I was tired, I left*, або *I was tired, so I left*.

questions.q: I called her, ___ she didn't answer.
questions.why: Протиставлення — *but* (або *yet*): дзвонила, але вона не відповіла.

questions.q: It was cold, ___ I put on a coat.
questions.why: Наслідок — *so*: було холодно, тому я вдягнув пальто.

questions.q: We can meet on Monday ___ Tuesday.
questions.why: Вибір — *or*: понеділок або вівторок.

questions.q: ___ my brother and my sister are doctors.
questions.why: *Both … and* — «і … і»: *Both my brother and my sister are doctors.*

questions.q: She speaks not only English ___ also French.
questions.why: *not only … but also* — «не тільки …, а й»: *not only English but also French*.

questions.q: I'm hungry ___ I didn't have breakfast.
questions.why: Причина (не снідав) — *because*.

questions.q: He didn't come ___ the snow.
questions.why: Перед іменником (*the snow*) — *because of*. *because* вимагає підрядного речення з дієсловом.

questions.q: ___ Anna nor her husband eats meat.
questions.why: *Neither … nor*: *Neither Anna nor her husband eats meat.*

questions.q: You can pay ___ by card or in cash.
questions.why: *either … or* — один із двох варіантів: *either by card or in cash*.

answer: I was tired so I went to bed
I was tired, so I went to bed
questions.why: *so* вводить наслідок: *I was tired, so I went to bed.*

answer: She stayed at home because she was ill
Because she was ill she stayed at home
questions.why: *because* + причина. Можна почати й з неї: *Because she was ill, she stayed at home.*

answer: Both Tom and Kate passed the exam
questions.why: *Both … and*: *Both Tom and Kate passed the exam.*
questions.hint: І Том, і Кейт склали іспит.

questions.q: I don't eat meat, and my sister doesn't ___.
questions.why: У запереченні «теж не» — *either* в кінці: *my sister doesn't either*. *too* і *also* — для ствердження.

questions.q: ___ English, she speaks German and Polish.
questions.why: *Apart from* (крім того, що) + іменник: *Apart from English, she speaks…* *Besides of* — помилка (правильно *Besides*).

questions.q: She plays the guitar as well ___ the piano.
questions.why: *as well as* — «так само як і»: *the guitar as well as the piano*.
